signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> [CommRing R] -> {S : Type u_3} -> [CommRing S] -> [Algebra R S] -> {I : Ideal S} -> {M : Type u_4} -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> (f : ↥I →ₗ[R] M) -> (hf : ∀ (x y : ↥I), f (x * y) = 0) -> I.Cotangent →ₗ[R] M

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is guarded by the explicit hypothesis hf, so it is only ever applied when the vanishing condition holds; there are no junk-value or edge conventions to declare.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (I : Ideal S) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : ↥I →ₗ[R] M) (hf : ∀ (x y : ↥I), f (x * y) = 0), Function.Surjective (VTask.lift f hf) ↔ Function.Surjective f
